claimBoundary: This registration covers only the synthetic fail-closed software check that per-cell establishment.startEvent matches the configured transplanting event.

The OSU source row is used for transplanting event identity only. No cultivar-specific target, maturity or harvest claim is made.
No numeric model output or external crop-data comparison is in scope; no numeric tolerance applies.
No measured establishment state, biological validity, crop accuracy, independent reference agreement, or prediction is established.
